title: Minih System Output
description: Required output contract for every minih agent run. Every agent must produce a summary and retrospective feedback.

summary.description: Single paragraph summarizing what happened during this run.

workedWell.description: What about the experience worked well? Be specific.

confusing.description: What was confusing, unclear, or required trial-and-error?

magicWand.description: If you had a magic wand, what ONE thing would you change about the harness, prompt, or agent config? Be concrete.
